snippet.title: The Walking Pet (Ketchapp)
snippet.description:
iOs : https://itunes.apple.com/app/the-walking-pet/id1021592731

Google Play : https://play.google.com/store/apps/details?id=com.ketchapp.thewalkingpet

If you think that walking on two legs is easy, the pets do not think so! Be a cat, a cow or a crocodile and try to walk on two legs. How far you can go?
